name: vaibot-codex-circuitbreaker
description: VAIBot AI agent governance for Codex CLI — intercepts tool calls, classifies risk, enforces policy, and creates tamper-evident audit receipts with on-chain provenance anchoring.

interface.shortDescription: Real-time governance + signed audit receipts for every Codex tool call
interface.longDescription: VAIBot intercepts every tool call your Codex agent attempts — Bash, apply_patch, MCP tools — classifies risk, enforces policy (allow / approval-required / deny), and writes a cryptographically signed audit receipt anchored on Base. Pairs the same governance surface used by the Claude Code and OpenClaw plugins; one VAIBot account works across all three. Auto-bootstraps a free tier on first run; pay-as-you-go USDC or subscription for production volumes.
